note: Budgets with ~15% headroom over measured values. Initial JS (entry + modulepreloads in index.html) was 76.5 kB raw / 28.6 kB gzip on 2026-11-03 after splitting module screens into on-demand chunks (single bundle before: 153.3 kB / 51.1 kB). Totals sum every chunk compressed separately, so splitting adds per-file gzip overhead; total JS gzip was raised from 60 kB to 70 kB for that reason and for the navigation shell (+~5 kB gzip). Raise only with justification in the PR. Value-first MVP (2026-11-03): total JS raised to 215 kB / 80 kB for the role reading of Mission Control (separate chunk, about 11 kB gzip); initial JS budget unchanged. UX Comercial e Economia (2026-11-03): CSS raw raised from 16 kB to 18.5 kB (measured 17.8 kB) because Economia had almost no layout of its own (tabs, decision queue, type picker); CSS gzip and every JS budget unchanged, total JS gzip is now close to its limit at 79.7 kB. Catus brand (2026-11-04): CSS raw raised to 20 kB: the token layer alone (custom properties, @font-face) costs about 1.08 kB raw and the same stylesheet without it measures 18.6 kB, so the old 18.5 kB would mean giving up the design system; CSS gzip and every JS budget unchanged. fontBytes is a new budget for the two self-hosted WOFF2 files, already compressed, excluded from the CSS totals (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md).
